title: Ready for B1 - Test 5 - Part 2 (Multiple Choice)
instruction: Bạn sẽ nghe 6 đoạn hội thoại ngắn. Với mỗi câu, chọn đáp án đúng A, B hoặc C.
fullScript:
Question 8. You will hear a boy talking to his doctor.
Doctor: Hello Sam, what seems to be the trouble?
Sam: Well, I've got a really bad cold and a headache.
Doctor: I see. And how long have you been feeling like this?
Sam: Well, the headache only started yesterday, but I've had a cold for a week. I didn't go to school for the last two days and my mom made me stay in bed, but I still don't feel any better.
Doctor: Okay, let's have a look at you.

Question 9. You will hear two friends talking about a film.
Lizzie: So, did you have a good weekend, Dan?
Dan: It was okay. I went to the cinema with my friends on Sunday afternoon.
Lizzie: Really? What did you see?
Dan: The new Shadow Hunters film. I thought it was pretty cool.
Lizzie: That's funny. I saw that on Sunday too, but I didn't see you at the cinema. Was it the 3:00 showing?
Dan: Yes, but we got there a bit late and sat at the back of the cinema.
Lizzie: Well, I was at the back of the Odeon too. How strange?
Dan: Ah, that explains it, Lizzie. I saw it at the Plaza. That's why we didn't see each other.

Question 10. You will hear a girl talking about a holiday.
Friend: How was your holiday at the water sports centre? Did you go windsurfing?
Julia: Yes, I did. I found that the windsurfing course I did last year was a big help, because I could go straight out on the water. I tried sailing too, but I didn't really like it.
Friend: Why not? I love sailing.
Julia: Well, I expected it to be more exciting, but you spend most of your time just sitting in a boat.
Friend: Hm, I don't think that's quite true, Julia. Anyway, did you do any other water sports?
Julia: Well, lots of people were having lessons in water skiing, but I didn't have enough time for that. I preferred to spend the week just windsurfing in the end, to be honest.

Question 11. You will hear a conversation in a shoe shop.
Girl: Look at these shoes, Ben. Do you like them? Are the heels too high?
Ben: I think the heels are okay, but I don't really like the color. They're a bit boring, too much like school shoes. What about these silver ones?
Girl: Ben, are you crazy? I can't go to the party in silver shoes. But you're right about the color of the others.
Girl: Oh dear, this is really annoying. Mum says that if I don't find something today, I'll have to wear the shoes I had at my sister's wedding.
Ben: Well, what about those blue ones over there?
Girl: Wow, I totally love those ones. You're brilliant, Ben.

Question 12. You will hear a boy talking about his new dog Zorro.
Friend: Is that a photo of your new dog, Zorro? He's so sweet.
Boy: Yeah, this is Zorro. He's a bit crazy.
Friend: Actually, I think he looks a lot like your old dog.
Boy: Hm, maybe he looks similar in this photo, but Zorro's a lot bigger than Jasper was, and he's much friendlier. But I miss Jasper, of course. He wasn't very friendly, and he was much lazier than Zorro, but for me, he was the best dog ever.

Question 13. You will hear two friends talking about their future.
Harry: So, have you thought about what you'll do when you leave school yet, Jessie?
Jessie: No, not really. I suppose I'll go to university, but I don't know what to study, and I really don't know what job I'll end up doing. I'd quite like to work with animals, but I really hate biology, so I can't be a vet like my dad. What about you, Harry? What will you do?
Harry: Well, I want to do a gap year before university. Then I'm going to study medicine. Both of my parents are doctors and it's such an important job. I hope that one day I'll do that too.
